title: Couette-Poiseuille flow over a drawn off-grid wall (laminar flow, Bouzidi walls, analytic)
description:
Steady flow in a periodic channel: a solid rectangle drawn up to y_w (no viscosity = a wall at rest) whose edge lies off the cell faces, a wall sliding at U_wall along +x on the y_hi face, and a body force G along x. solver_defaults.conformal_boundaries is on: each fluid cell next to the drawn wall takes the linear interpolated (Bouzidi) bounce-back at the wall's true position along its links, instead of the halfway bounce-back on the cell face. The sweep moves the wall through one cell (s_wall: y_w = (1 + s_wall) dx), so the first fluid link is cut at delta = 0.1-0.9 of its length on both sides of 1/2.
Analytic: with h = H_dom - y_w, u_x = U (y - y_w)/h + G (y - y_w)(H_dom - y)/(2 mu) above the wall, 0 inside it.
Derived values tab: u_mid (cell centre y = 10.5 um) and u_near (y = 4.5 um, ~3 cells above the wall) vs their references; expect ~1e-3 (linear Bouzidi + TRT: an O(dx^2) slip that depends weakly on the relaxation time). Switch Follow curved walls off (Solvers node) to compare: the halfway wall sits on the nearest cell face, ~10 % off at u_near and ~2 % at u_mid.
Sweep tab: u_mid and u_near vs s_wall with the dashed analytic lines.
Line profile tab (last value s_wall = 0.3): u_profile across the channel incl. the solid cells (both 0 there); expect ~1e-3 of the profile range.

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s

parameters.name: rho_f
parameters.description: liquid density in kg/m^3 (also given to the solid, as rho must be set)

parameters.name: H_dom
parameters.description: domain height; the moving wall is the y_hi face

parameters.name: L_ch
parameters.description: length of the periodic cell along x

parameters.name: s_wall
parameters.description: wall offset inside its cell (swept 0.1-0.9; 0.5 would put the wall on a cell centre)

parameters.name: y_w
parameters.description: height of the drawn wall (top of the solid rectangle)

parameters.name: h_ch
parameters.description: channel height between the drawn wall and the y_hi face

parameters.name: U_wall
parameters.description: speed of the y_hi wall along +x in m/s

parameters.name: G_drive
parameters.description: body force density along x in N/m^3 (shape factor ~1.5 at h = 18 um)

parameters.name: y_near
parameters.description: near-wall probe height (cell centre, ~3 cells above the wall)

parameters.name: u_mid_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_x at y_mid in m/s

parameters.name: u_near_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_x at y_near in m/s
